title: Bundle manifest
description: Lists every file in a published data bundle. Published at data/v1/manifest.json; the app checks it at most once a day.

dataSchemaVersion.description: The chain and meal-deal schema version. A breaking change publishes under a new data/vN/ path, so older apps keep reading theirs.

version.description: Publish time as an integer, YYYYMMDDHHmm in UTC. The app installs a bundle only when this is higher than the one it has.

isRelease.description: True when the bundle contains verified, non-placeholder data only. The app's release build refuses anything else.

path.description: Relative to the manifest. Raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951), which Apple's NSData zlib decompression reads.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the uncompressed JSON. Unchanged content keeps its hash, so the app downloads only what changed.
